spanish: O alma, cuando jurare a pronunciar con labios a hacer mal o a hacer bien, a todo lo que pronunciare el adam en juramento, y se ocultare desde él, y él conociere, y culpado a una desde estas.

findings.issue: הָאָדָם is a definite common noun (H120); adam leaves that lemma untranslated instead of a Spanish common noun.
The suffix is 1st person common plural (from us); él is 3rd person masculine singular.
Qal perfect יָדַע and sequential perfect וְאָשֵׁם are flattened: conociere is future subjunctive, and culpado is a bare participle rather than a finite 3ms predicate.

notes: The other clauses stay inside the token senses, including כי as cuando and the repeated piel of H981.
